name: Paris, France
tagline: Christmas markets, lit boulevards, Versailles day trip
whyParents: Their favorite city, dressed for Christmas, with Versailles an easy train ride away.

costPP.flightsBasis: aa.com snapshot Oct 2026: PHL-CDG RT $786 for Dec 2-9 2026; mid-Dec dates likely a bit higher
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$90/day food + metro, plus Versailles ticket and RER

flight.routing: PHL-CDG nonstop (AA; fares on sale for Dec 2026)
flight.notes: Alt: Air France or Delta JFK-CDG nonstop; Air France bookable with Capital One miles via Flying Blue.

stay: Le Marais (3e/4e): walkable, central, great food
getAround: Metro and RER plus walking; no car. RER C to Versailles (~40 min). Taxi or RER B from CDG.
entry: Passport valid 3+ months past exit. No visa, 90/180 days. EES biometrics live since Apr 10 2026; ETIAS not yet required.
events: Tuileries Christmas market: Nov 14 2026 to Jan 3 2027 (Sortiraparis; lineup not yet announced)
La Défense Christmas market: Nov 12 to Dec 31 2026, ~300 chalets plus ice rink
Galeries Lafayette: Castelbajac-designed windows and dome tree unveiled mid-Nov 2026; rooftop rink from Nov 24 2026
Schengen 90/180 rule: max 90 days in any 180-day window; this trip uses 6 to 7 days.
pros: Markets and store windows at peak

itinerary.plan: Land CDG, check in, walk the Seine at dusk, see Eiffel Tower sparkle on the hour.
itinerary.eat: Onion soup at Au Pied de Cochon

name: Paris + Strasbourg and Colmar, France
tagline: Paris plus France's most famous Christmas markets
whyParents: Paris sparkle plus storybook Alsace villages, Europe's classic Christmas market capital, linked by fast TGV.

costPP.flightsBasis: aa.com snapshot Oct 2026: PHL-CDG RT $786 for Dec 2-9 2026
costPP.lodgingBasis: Paris 3BR ~$400/night x3 + Strasbourg 3BR ~$300/night x3, split 4 ways (estimate)
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$90/day food, plus TGV Paris-Strasbourg RT ~$120 and Colmar train

flight.routing: PHL-CDG nonstop (AA; fares on sale for Dec 2026)
flight.notes: TGV from CDG airport station direct to Strasbourg also possible. Alt: Air France via Flying Blue.

weather.precip: cold, frequent gray days, some snow possible in Alsace

stay: Paris: Le Marais. Strasbourg: Grande Île, steps from markets
getAround: TGV Paris Est to Strasbourg ~1h50; TER Strasbourg to Colmar ~30 min. Walk and tram locally; no car.
entry: Passport valid 3+ months past exit. No visa, 90/180 days. EES biometrics live since Apr 10 2026; ETIAS not yet required.
events: Strasbourg Christkindelsmärik: opens Fri Nov 27 2026; close expected Dec 24 (end date not yet official)
Colmar Christmas markets: Nov 23 to Dec 29 2026 (six markets)
Paris Tuileries market Nov 14 2026 to Jan 3 2027; La Défense Nov 12 to Dec 31 2026
Schengen 90/180 rule: max 90 days in any 180-day window; this trip uses 6 to 7 days.
pros: Mix of big city and villages
cons: Two hotel moves in a week

name: Lisbon + Porto, Portugal
tagline: Mild weather, festive lights, port and pastries
whyParents: Europe's mildest winter capital, cheap and charming, with port cellars and a scenic train north.

costPP.flightsBasis: aa.com snapshots Oct 2026: PHL-LIS RT $764 (Nov 11-18) and $771 (Oct 28-Nov 4); no Dec fare seen
costPP.lodgingBasis: Lisbon 3BR ~$220/night x4 + Porto 3BR ~$180/night x2, split 4 ways (estimate)
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$70/day food and transit, plus Alfa Pendular ~€36 and Sintra tickets

flight.routing: PHL-LIS nonstop (AA, operates through winter; 787-9 to Dec 1, then 787-8)
flight.notes: Return from Porto via TAP connection in Lisbon. Alt: TAP EWR/JFK-LIS nonstop (TAP Miles&Go via Capital One).

stay: Lisbon: Chiado/Baixa, flat and central. Porto: Ribeira
getAround: Walk, trams and metro; Uber cheap. Alfa Pendular Lisbon to Porto ~2h40, €35.70. Train to Sintra 40 min.
entry: Passport valid 3+ months past exit. No visa, 90/180 days. EES biometrics live since Apr 10 2026; ETIAS not yet required.
events: Wonderland Lisboa, Parque Eduardo VII: press reports Nov 27 2026 opening (organizer unconfirmed); 2025 ran Nov 28 to Jan 4, free entry
Lisbon Christmas lights: 2026 switch-on date not yet announced
Schengen 90/180 rule: max 90 days in any 180-day window; this trip uses 6 to 7 days.

name: Athens, Greece
tagline: Acropolis without crowds, Delphi and Sounion
whyParents: Ancient wonders with almost no lines, mild sunny days, and great food at low prices.

costPP.flightsBasis: Kayak: NYC-ATH one-stop Dec 3-9 RT $632 (Air Serbia); Dec average $773 to $982
costPP.foodFunBasis: ~$65/day food, plus Acropolis tickets and Delphi tour or rental car

flight.notes: AA PHL-ATH ends Oct 23 2026; no AA nonstop in Dec. AA option: connect via LHR/MAD with oneworld partners.

weather.precip: some rain ~10 days/month, many sunny days

stay: Plaka or Koukaki: walk to Acropolis
getAround: Metro from airport, walk the center. Delphi ~2h30 by car: midsize sedan or tour. Sounion ~1h15 coastal drive.
entry: Passport valid 3+ months past exit. No visa, 90/180 days. EES biometrics live since Apr 10 2026; ETIAS not yet required.
events: Syntagma Square Christmas tree: lit late Nov (Nov 28 2024, Nov 27 2025); 2026 date not yet found
Islands mostly shut in December: ferries reduced, most island hotels and tavernas closed
Schengen 90/180 rule: max 90 days in any 180-day window; this trip uses 6 to 7 days.
cons: Delphi needs a car or tour

itinerary.eat: Souvlaki at Kostas, Agia Irini Square
